facts.text: 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CyberSecurity Breakthrough , a leading independent market intelligence organization that recognizes the top companies and technologies in the global information security market, today announced the winners of its 10 th annual CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards program, marking a full decade of recognizing breakthrough cybersecurity innovation.

The 2026 awards program received thousands of nominations from organizations in more than 20 countries around the world, representing breakthrough technologies from disruptive startups to established global enterprises.
This year’s winners embody the cutting edge of cybersecurity technology, delivering next generation protection and resilience in today’s increasingly complex threat landscape.
“When we launched CyberSecurity Breakthrough ten years ago, the industry was focused on building higher walls around the network.

A decade later, there is no perimeter left to defend, attackers are operating with AI at machine speed, and cybersecurity has become the foundation of trust for every business, government and consumer,” said Steve Johansson, Managing Director, CyberSecurity Breakthrough.
Congratulations to all of our 2026 CyberSecurity Breakthrough Award winners.”
Winners were chosen based on a range of criteria, with a focus on innovation, technological advancement, and the overall impact of their solutions in advancing the cybersecurity industry.
Tech Breakthrough LLC does not endorse any vendor, product or service depicted in our recognition programs, and does not advise technology users to select only those vendors with award designations.
Threat Intelligence Threat Detection Solution of the Year: Booz Allen Threat Intelligence Company of the Year: Anomali Threat Intelligence Innovation Award: CSC, 3D Domain Security and Enforcement

9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anjuna Security , a leader in confidential computing and autonomous software runtime governance, today announced that Anjuna Northstar has been recognized as the winner of the "Data Privacy Solution of the Year" award in the 10 th annual CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards program.

Over that decade, the program has grown to span a wide range of categories, including Cloud Security, Threat Intelligence, Risk Management, Fraud Prevention, Mobile Security, Application Security, Identity Management, and more, consistently shining a light on the solutions and organizations redefining how we safeguard the digital world.
"Traditional clean rooms lack the flexibility and scalability required to meet the demands of today's data-driven, security-first enterprises," said Ayal Yogev, CEO of Anjuna Security.
This win with CyberSecurity Breakthrough validates our approach to liberate organizations from the constraints of data sharing.
This year's winners embody the cutting edge of cybersecurity technology, delivering next-generation protection and resilience in today's increasingly complex threat landscape.

AI models offer new ways to analyze, predict, and innovate, but also introduce a range of risk vectors that traditional tools, like legacy data clean rooms, were not designed to protect against," said Steve Johansson, managing director, CyberSecurity Breakthrough.
Tech Breakthrough LLC does not endorse any vendor, product or service depicted in our recognition programs, and does not advise technology users to select only those vendors with award designations.
Remote attestation and data-in-use isolation enable companies to reduce risks and guarantee the highest level of privacy and security for every collaboration.
